COM.note: Article is about press freedom; nothing on civil-service digital skills.

facts.fact: Mayotte Hebdo says police arrested Al-Watwan correspondent Abdou Moustoifa on 17 November 2025 over a Facebook post about migrants held in a Moroni police station and questioned him for over two hours to learn his source.

Mayotte Hebdo says the Comorian press mobilised in December 2025 against a ministry and CNPA proposal to amend article 169 of the Information Code on source protection, and the journalists' union SNJC obtained its withdrawal.

COM.note: Police appear only as questioning a journalist; no station records system stated.
